#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract CapStruct/CapRef and the following Base/Size from HTML snippets.

Expected pattern:
  <TR><TD><A HREF="#CapStruct">CapRef</A></TD>
  ...next line(s)... <TD>Base</TD><TD><B>Address Range:</B> Size<BR>
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import html
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List

# Match: <A HREF="#CapStruct">CapRef</A>
ANCHOR_RE = re.compile(
    r"<A\s+HREF=\"#(?P<cap_struct>[^\"]+)\"\s*>\s*(?P<cap_ref>.*?)\s*</A>",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Match Base from: <TD>Base</TD>
BASE_RE = re.compile(r"<TD>\s*(?P<base>.*?)\s*</TD>", re.IGNORECASE)

# Match Size from: <B>Address Range:</B> Size<BR>
SIZE_RE = re.compile(
    r"<B>\s*Address\s+Range:\s*</B>\s*(?P<size>.*?)\s*<BR>",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _clean_text(value: str) -> str:
    """Remove HTML tags and normalize spaces for readable output."""
    no_tags = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", value)
    return " ".join(html.unescape(no_tags).split())


def parse_caps(text: str, lookahead_lines: int = 6) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Extract cap_struct/cap_ref and nearby base/size from HTML text."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    results: List[Dict[str, str]] = []

    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        anchor_match = ANCHOR_RE.search(line)
        if not anchor_match:
            continue

        cap_struct = _clean_text(anchor_match.group("cap_struct"))
        cap_ref = _clean_text(anchor_match.group("cap_ref"))

        base = ""
        size = ""

        # Search only in subsequent lines, per requirement "next line".
        end_idx = min(len(lines), idx + 1 + lookahead_lines)
        for next_idx in range(idx + 1, end_idx):
            candidate = lines[next_idx]

            if not base:
                base_match = BASE_RE.search(candidate)
                if base_match:
                    base = _clean_text(base_match.group("base"))

            if not size:
                size_match = SIZE_RE.search(candidate)
                if size_match:
                    size = _clean_text(size_match.group("size"))

            if base and size:
                break

        results.append(
            {
                "cap_struct": cap_struct,
                "cap_ref": cap_ref,
                "base": base,
                "size": size,
            }
        )

    return results


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Extract CapStruct/CapRef and next-line Base/Size from HTML."
    )
    parser.add_argument("input", type=Path, help="Input HTML/text file path")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Output JSON instead of tab-separated text",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    text = args.input.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    records = parse_caps(text)

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return

    print("cap_struct\tcap_ref\tbase\tsize")
    for item in records:
        print(
            f"{item['cap_struct']}\t{item['cap_ref']}\t"
            f"{item['base']}\t{item['size']}"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract CapStruct/CapRef, Base/Size, and nested CapDwReg defaults from HTML."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import html
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List

# Match: <A HREF="#CapStruct">CapRef</A>
CAP_REF_RE = re.compile(
    r"<A\s+HREF=\"#(?P<cap_struct>[^\"]+)\"\s*>\s*(?P<cap_ref>.*?)\s*</A>",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Match: <p><a NAME="CapStruct"></a></p>
CAP_NAME_RE = re.compile(
    r"<A\s+NAME=\"(?P<cap_struct>[^\"]+)\"\s*>\s*</A>",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Match: <TR><TD><A HREF="#CapDwReg">RefDwReg</A></TD>
DWREG_REF_RE = re.compile(
    r"<A\s+HREF=\"#(?P<cap_dw_reg>[^\"]+)\"\s*>\s*(?P<ref_dw_reg>.*?)\s*</A>",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Match Base from: <TD>Base</TD>
BASE_RE = re.compile(r"<TD>\s*(?P<base>.*?)\s*</TD>", re.IGNORECASE)

# Match Size from: <B>Address Range:</B> Size<BR>
SIZE_RE = re.compile(
    r"<B>\s*Address\s+Range:\s*</B>\s*(?P<size>.*?)\s*<BR>",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Match default from: <B>Value After Reset:</B> CapDwRegDefault<BR>
RESET_VALUE_RE = re.compile(
    r"<B>\s*Value\s+After\s+Reset:\s*</B>\s*(?P<default>.*?)\s*<BR>",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _clean_text(value: str) -> str:
    """Remove HTML tags and normalize spaces for readable output."""
    no_tags = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", value)
    return " ".join(html.unescape(no_tags).split())


def _extract_base_and_size(lines: List[str], start_idx: int, lookahead_lines: int) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """Extract base and size from lines following a CapStruct reference row."""
    base = ""
    size = ""
    end_idx = min(len(lines), start_idx + 1 + lookahead_lines)

    for next_idx in range(start_idx + 1, end_idx):
        candidate = lines[next_idx]

        if not base:
            base_match = BASE_RE.search(candidate)
            if base_match:
                base = _clean_text(base_match.group("base"))

        if not size:
            size_match = SIZE_RE.search(candidate)
            if size_match:
                size = _clean_text(size_match.group("size"))

        if base and size:
            break

    return {"base": base, "size": size}


def _extract_dwregs(lines: List[str], start_idx: int, end_idx: int, lookahead_lines: int) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Extract CapDwReg entries and reset defaults inside a CapStruct block."""
    dwregs: List[Dict[str, str]] = []

    for idx in range(start_idx, end_idx):
        dwreg_match = DWREG_REF_RE.search(lines[idx])
        if not dwreg_match:
            continue

        cap_dw_reg = _clean_text(dwreg_match.group("cap_dw_reg"))
        ref_dw_reg = _clean_text(dwreg_match.group("ref_dw_reg"))
        default = ""

        search_end = min(end_idx, idx + 1 + lookahead_lines)
        for next_idx in range(idx + 1, search_end):
            default_match = RESET_VALUE_RE.search(lines[next_idx])
            if default_match:
                default = _clean_text(default_match.group("default"))
                break

        dwregs.append(
            {
                "cap_dw_reg": cap_dw_reg,
                "ref_dw_reg": ref_dw_reg,
                "default": default,
            }
        )

    return dwregs


def parse_caps(text: str, lookahead_lines: int = 6) -> List[Dict[str, object]]:
    """Extract CapStruct metadata and nested CapDwReg entries from HTML text."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    results: List[Dict[str, object]] = []
    cap_refs: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
    cap_sections: List[Dict[str, int | str]] = []

    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        cap_ref_match = CAP_REF_RE.search(line)
        if cap_ref_match:
            cap_struct = _clean_text(cap_ref_match.group("cap_struct"))
            cap_ref = _clean_text(cap_ref_match.group("cap_ref"))
            cap_refs[cap_struct] = {
                "cap_ref": cap_ref,
                **_extract_base_and_size(lines, idx, lookahead_lines),
            }

        cap_name_match = CAP_NAME_RE.search(line)
        if cap_name_match:
            cap_sections.append(
                {
                    "cap_struct": _clean_text(cap_name_match.group("cap_struct")),
                    "start_idx": idx + 1,
                }
            )

    for idx, section in enumerate(cap_sections):
        cap_struct = str(section["cap_struct"])
        start_idx = int(section["start_idx"])
        end_idx = len(lines)

        if idx + 1 < len(cap_sections):
            end_idx = int(cap_sections[idx + 1]["start_idx"]) - 1

        cap_info = cap_refs.get(cap_struct, {"cap_ref": "", "base": "", "size": ""})
        results.append(
            {
                "cap_struct": cap_struct,
                "cap_ref": str(cap_info.get("cap_ref", "")),
                "base": str(cap_info.get("base", "")),
                "size": str(cap_info.get("size", "")),
                "dwregs": _extract_dwregs(lines, start_idx, end_idx, lookahead_lines),
            }
        )

    return results


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Extract CapStruct/CapRef, Base/Size, and nested CapDwReg defaults."
    )
    parser.add_argument("input", type=Path, help="Input HTML/text file path")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Output JSON instead of tab-separated text",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    text = args.input.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    records = parse_caps(text)

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return

    print("cap_struct\tcap_ref\tbase\tsize\tcap_dw_reg\tref_dw_reg\tdefault")
    for item in records:
        dwregs = item["dwregs"]
        if not dwregs:
            print(
                f"{item['cap_struct']}\t{item['cap_ref']}\t"
                f"{item['base']}\t{item['size']}\t\t\t"
            )
            continue

        for dwreg in dwregs:
            print(
                f"{item['cap_struct']}\t{item['cap_ref']}\t"
                f"{item['base']}\t{item['size']}\t"
                f"{dwreg['cap_dw_reg']}\t{dwreg['ref_dw_reg']}\t{dwreg['default']}"
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
